description: t01 direct boot on i76.exe. From the hand-over (car at ~24 m/s near (3607, 36322) heading ~29 deg) drive_to the barn 'bhbarn1' ODEF/OBJ#64 at (3750, 36730) (432 m, bearing 19 deg; the saguaro cluster nsagu* at (3755-3825, 36715-36765) stands in front of it) and ram it for 3 s, so physics_ApplyCollisionDamage fires IMPACT events (type 3, i_0 = 1) on the player. Then the trainer pokes (i76trainer.Game.wr): armour side 0 to 10% (scaled branch: object_HealthFraction = 28 + 72 x 0.1 = 35.2 -> smoke at the next hit), ram again; engine to 50% (unscaled branch: health_pct 0.5) and front-left wheel to 25%; ram again, back off in reverse and ram once more. t01 ends about 45 s after the hand-over (frame counter frozen), so the recording's tail is static. I76_FIX_HEALTH_PCT is off (stock health fraction).
